Roth }} '''Dread Banner''' is a [[banner]] [[aura]] [[skill]]. After gaining [[Valour]] from melee combat, it can be activated, consuming all Valour and placing a banner that [[buff]]s the user and [[allies]] within an area with additional chance to [[block]] attack damage and life gain on block. The effect of the aura is multiplied based on the amount of Valour consumed. ==Mechanics== ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Aura Effect
per Valour |c1_header = x% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = AoE
per Valour |c2_header = x% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_value = %s%% |c3_abbr = Life gain
on block |c3_header = Banner causes you and Allies to Recover x Life when Blocking |c3_pattern_extract = Banner causes you and Allies to Recover (%d+)% Life when Blocking |c3_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Dread Banner cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Dread Banner: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Dread%Banner%" OR items.name LIKE "%Perfidy%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Dread Banner%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Dread Banner%" OR items.description LIKE "%your banner%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer has the Physical tag, is no longer a Reservation skill, and has none of its previous stats. You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. While you have no placed banner, you can gain Valour. Now has a base duration of 10.00 seconds, and a base radius of 2.4 metres. Provides 5% more Area of Effect and 5% more Aura effect per Valour consumed at gem level 1, both scaling up to 10% at gem level 20. Banner grants +4% Chance to Block Attack Damage to You and Allies. The Banner also causes you and Allies to Recover 9 Life when Blocking at gem level 1, scaling up to 34 at gem level 20. Now has a Mana cost of 15 at gem level 1, and 19 at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Dread Banner now grants {{c|mod|+10 to maximum Fortification for 0.05 seconds per Stage}} when placed. It no longer grants {{c|mod|1% increased Fortify Effect per Stage}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now has 1% increased Fortify Effect per Stage (previously 2%). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Dread Banner has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
